# Control plane

Every `/__unit/*` route -- the operator's side channel for state, time and observability -- identical for every vendor; generated against a `clover` unit, filtered to paths under `/__unit/`.

| Method | Path | Operation | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/__unit/auth` | UnitAuth | How to authenticate, and credentials that currently work. |
| GET | `/__unit/capabilities` | UnitCapabilities | Capability state. |
| POST | `/__unit/capabilities` | UnitSetCapabilities | Toggle capabilities at runtime. |
| GET | `/__unit/chaos` | UnitChaos | Active chaos rules with their counters and fire history. |
| POST | `/__unit/chaos/reset` | UnitResetChaos | Drop all rules and counters. |
| POST | `/__unit/chaos/rules` | UnitAddChaosRule | Add one rule, or replace the whole set. |
| DELETE | `/__unit/chaos/rules/{id}` | UnitRemoveChaosRule | Remove one rule. |
| POST | `/__unit/clock/advance` | UnitAdvanceClock | Virtual clock only: jump forward and fire due timers. |
| POST | `/__unit/echo` | UnitEcho | Reflect the parsed request body, whatever content type carried it. |
| GET | `/__unit/errors` | UnitErrors | Every core error kind as this vendor shapes it. |
| GET | `/__unit/health` | UnitHealth | Liveness probe. |
| GET | `/__unit/info` | UnitInfo | Everything needed to reproduce this unit run. |
| GET | `/__unit/journal` | UnitJournal | Append-only log of committed state mutations. |
| GET | `/__unit/machines` | UnitMachines | Declared state machines, with terminal states derived. |
| POST | `/__unit/machines/probe` | UnitProbeMachine | Evaluate a transition without mutating state. |
| GET | `/__unit/requests` | UnitRequests | Every request the unit handled, newest first. |
| DELETE | `/__unit/requests` | UnitClearRequests | Forget every recorded request. State is untouched. |
| GET | `/__unit/requests/unmatched/near-misses` | UnitNearMisses | Unmatched requests, each with the routes it nearly asked for. |
| GET | `/__unit/routes` | UnitRoutes | The unit surface, for docs and drift checks. |
| GET | `/__unit/state` | UnitState | Entity counts and the state digest. |
| POST | `/__unit/state/page` | UnitStatePage | Page a collection through the store's cursor. |
| POST | `/__unit/state/reset` | UnitStateReset | Wipe state and re-apply the seed scenario. |
| POST | `/__unit/state/restore` | UnitStateRestore | Replace state with a previous snapshot. |
| GET | `/__unit/state/snapshot` | UnitStateSnapshot | Full state, restorable into another unit. |
| POST | `/__unit/state/update` | UnitStateUpdate | Commit one mutation under optimistic concurrency. |
| GET | `/__unit/webhooks/deliveries` | UnitDeliveries | Every delivery attempt, with headers and signature. |
| POST | `/__unit/webhooks/drain` | UnitDrain | Wait for in-flight deliveries to settle. |
| POST | `/__unit/webhooks/emit` | UnitEmitEvent | Enqueue a synthetic event through the real delivery path. |
| POST | `/__unit/webhooks/retry-policy` | UnitSetRetryPolicy | Adjust the retry schedule scaling at runtime. |
| POST | `/__unit/webhooks/sink` | UnitProgramSink | Program the in-memory sink's next responses. |
| GET | `/__unit/webhooks/subscriptions` | UnitSubscriptions | Subscribers the dispatcher knows about. |
| POST | `/__unit/webhooks/subscriptions` | UnitAddSubscription | Register a subscriber without using the vendor API. |
| DELETE | `/__unit/webhooks/subscriptions/{id}` | UnitRemoveSubscription | Remove a subscriber. |
